column1: # Rows db.rpt.* (line RG item D4): blastn -filtering_db tests/db_search/rpt_d4 (a database of repeats, README.md there) with -db tests/db_search/wm_s60k: the query ranges of the repeat hits mask the queries in every task and strand, joined to DUST's and the lower case within 4 letters (also next to a -query_loc interval), in split batches, in every report that shows the masks or the filter, the error of a database name NCBI cannot open, of an alias file's count, and of a batch without letters. The -subject cases are rpt.* of tests/blastn_regression_fixtures.py. Freeze them alone with `freeze --program blastn --only db.rpt.`.

column12: covers
D4: megablast, the hits stop at the repeats (-soft_masking false)
D4: megablast, outfmt 0 shows the repeats' letters in lower case
D4: -task blastn
D4: -task dc-megablast
D4: -task blastn-short
D4: -strand plus: the repeat search takes the plus strand only (minus-strand repeats do not mask)
D4: -strand minus
D4: -dust no: the repeats alone
D4: -lcase_masking: the lower case joins the repeat hits within 4 letters
D4: archive: RepeatFilteringDB and LCaseMask with DUST, lower case and repeats joined
D4: archive with -strand minus
D4: XML Parameters_filter L;R -d <db>;m;
D4: JSON filter R -d <db>;m;
D4: XML2 filter without m;
D4: a query batch split into chunks of 600: each chunk searches its own letters for repeats
D4: the same with -strand minus and chunks of 400
D4: -query_loc: lower case 2 letters before the interval joins a repeat hit that starts 2 letters into it
D4: -query_loc: lower case 2 letters after the interval joins a repeat hit that ends 2 letters before its end
D4: the archive of the edge_lo search (the results' masks and LCaseMask)
D4: -query_loc with a split batch: the chunks join the masks before each part
D4: an empty database name: each query of the first batch posts NCBI's error as a warning, rc 3
D4: the same with one query per batch
D4: a batch whose queries have no letters: the search of the repeats stops at its set-up, and each query posts that stop's text as a warning, rc 3
D4: an alias file of repeats whose count NCBI cannot convert: each query of the batch posts the exception's message, rc 3
